dims.v: divine revulsion — the things the LORD hates
the LORD's hatred of the seven abominations about to be listed
the divine hatred that heads and condemns the list

sane (hate) — the LORD's own revulsion heading the numerical list (6:17-19); what God HATES defines the antithesis of wisdom. Locus external:god — the divine assessment, the arena against which the human vices are measured, not a human interior. ABOMINATION (toebah) and his SOUL (nephesh) are qualifiers.
